method.score_mode: task-level paired bootstrap: tasks resampled with replacement inside each of the 13 domains (subset-restricted), macro = mean over resampled tasks; B=2000 seed 0, same draws for all systems. item_normal: SE = sqrt(sum se_t^2)/T from the scorer's accuracy_se (per-question binomial, ddof 1); differences add SEs in quadrature (correlation 0, conservative under positive correlation).

item_mode.method: Per-item paired bootstrap from the extracted arrays: units (requests) resampled with replacement inside each task (S1) or dataset (BTZSC), the questions of a request together; for every draw each system gets macro - the official statistic: mean over the subset's tasks of per-task accuracy (S1), or mean over the subset's datasets of per-dataset macro-F1 (BTZSC); pooled - question-weighted accuracy over the subset (S1; BTZSC: mean per-dataset accuracy, `acc_macro`); ece10 - ECE, 10 equal-mass bins (e5/calib.py::ece_equal_mass), each task/dataset weighing equally; brier - multi-class Brier, same weighting. B=2000, seed 0, the same draws for every system and subset (paired).
